faq.q: Is registration of a rent agreement mandatory in Maharashtra?
faq.a: Yes. Under the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, a Leave & License agreement must be registered. An unregistered agreement is not valid evidence and attracts penalties.

faq.q: How is stamp duty calculated?
faq.a: For Leave & License (Article 36A), stamp duty is 0.25% of the total of: rent for the full period + any non-refundable deposit + 10% of the refundable deposit for each year of the term.

faq.q: What is the registration fee?
faq.a: ₹1,000 for properties in municipal / urban areas and ₹500 for properties in rural (Gram Panchayat) areas.

faq.q: Why is the agreement usually for 11 months?
faq.a: An 11-month term keeps registration simpler and is the common practice, though agreements can be made for any tenure both parties agree to.

faq.q: Do all parties need to be physically present?
faq.a: No. With e-registration and doorstep biometric (thumb impression), the process can be completed from home for owner, tenant and witnesses.

faq.q: What documents do I need?
faq.a: PAN and Aadhaar of owner and tenant, owner's ownership proof (Index II / electricity bill), passport photos, and two witnesses with ID.

faq.q: What are the stamp duty and registration charges in Pune?
faq.a: Within Pune municipal limits stamp duty is about 6% (5% state duty + 1% local cess) and the registration fee is 1% of the value, capped at ₹30,000. Charges are calculated on the higher of the agreement value or the government ready-reckoner rate.

faq.q: Is online property registration possible?
faq.a: You can fill details, pay stamp duty & fees and book the appointment online, but physical presence at the Sub-Registrar office for biometrics and signatures is mandatory. We handle the online steps and coordinate the visit.

faq.q: Why is title verification important?
faq.a: A 30-year title search and Encumbrance Certificate confirm the seller's ownership and that the property is free of loans, disputes or charges — protecting you before you pay.

faq.q: How long does registration take?
faq.a: Once documents are ready, execution and registration happen in a single appointment; the registered deed is typically available within 3–7 working days.

faq.q: Does PuneNest charge separately for this?
faq.a: Yes — legal services carry a transparent, fixed professional fee (separate from government stamp duty & registration charges), shared with you upfront before you proceed.
